leopard_as1.name: Leopard AS1
leopard_as1.authority: Main ruled the Australia line on 2026-11-02 (DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("flesh out south african and australian tank trees", "no senntinnel please"). The Leopard AS1 (90 gun tanks, 1976-2007) as the 'as1' mark of the Danish line's welded-turret Leopard 1A3 builder (profiles/leopard1Dk.ts): the SABCA laser drum in the left rangefinder port and the right blanked, the crosswind mast, the loader's MAG 58 and the Australian basket. No registered 3D comparison exists. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
leopard_as1.envelopeBasis: The as-built envelope of the fleet's Leopard 1A3 DK under the AS1's fit: 9.67 m over the L7A3 forward (armedconflicts 9.543 m, 1 %), 3.42 m over the skirts (3.37 m published, 2 %); the tallest point is the whip.
